Note: Candidates with Bachelor’s Degree of Science or Technology degrees or their equivalents (non-Engineering / Engineering Technology / Construction Management / Architecture / Architectural Technology) are required to take 2 bridging courses before commencing the programme. The MSc in Construction Management (Building Information Modelling) is designed to meet the needs of students who want to build a strong background in building information modelling systems and the application of information and communications technology in the construction industry. Every construction business worldwide has to invest in technology in order to maintain its competitive edge, with effective management of technological innovations as essential to daily construction operations as are construction costing or project monitoring. Construction companies today need managers who can understand how BIM technology can open new opportunities and restructure existing construction businesses. The MSc in Construction Management with Building Information Modelling programme is designed precisely with this in mind. Our curriculum combines technical knowledge courses with insightful courses focused on technology management in managing construction data.
